outcome: Caregiving burden (Zarit Burden Interview, social life, caregiver uncertainty)
cohort: The study evaluated 13 individuals aged 8 to 18 years diagnosed with Prader-Willi Syndrome through genetic testing, including 5 with scoliosis and 7 without.
finding: Individuals with Prader-Willi syndrome and scoliosis exhibited more pronounced delays in postural-motor milestones, lower lumbar extension values, and a heightened caregiving burden, particularly regarding social life and caregiver uncertainty, compared to those with PWS but no scoliosis.
